headline: 10 injured as Chhatra Dal attacks journalists at RU
summary: Four journalists from major outlets were among the 10 injured when Chhatra Dal activists used weapons to attack people at Rajshahi University.
details: At least 10 people, including four journalists, were injured in a violent attack by the Rajshahi University (RU) unit of Chhatra Dal. The incident occurred on Sunday night near the Shaheed Ziaur Rahman Hall.
caption:
10 people, including 4 journalists, injured in a violent attack at Rajshahi University.

At least 10 people, including four journalists, were injured in a violent attack by the Rajshahi University (RU) unit of Chhatra Dal. The incident occurred on Sunday night near the Shaheed Ziaur Rahman Hall.

headline_marked: 10-year journey ends: [[Pritom Hasan and Shahtaj Monira announce divorce]]
headline: 10-year journey ends: Pritom Hasan and Shahtaj Monira announce divorce
summary: The musician and model couple decided to separate due to significant differences in mutual understanding after nearly a decade together.
details: Musician and actor Pritom Hasan and model, actor and singer Shahtaj Monira Hashem have announced they are ending their marriage. The couple shared the decision in separate Facebook posts on Sunday night.

Pritom explained that after a ten-year journey together, they decided to separate due to significant differences in their mutual understanding. He noted that the decision was not sudden and was made after much thought and discussion.

Shahtaj shared a similar statement, confirming that the separation is amicable and based on mutual understanding. Both expressed gratitude for the memories and experiences they shared over the last decade.
The couple stated that the decision was reached with the support and consent of their families. They are currently going through the legal process of divorce.

Pritom and Shahtaj first met in 2017 while working on the music video for Pritom's song 'Jadukor', where Shahtaj appeared as a model. Their professional relationship later evolved into a romantic one.
They married on October 29, 2022, in Sreemangal, in the presence of family and close friends. They had been seen together as recently as January this year.
Both have requested respect for their privacy and personal space during this transition. They asked friends, colleagues, and the media to approach the matter with empathy.
caption:
After 10 years together, Pritom Hasan and Shahtaj Monira are parting ways.

Musician and actor Pritom Hasan and model, actor and singer Shahtaj Monira Hashem have announced they are ending their marriage. The couple shared the decision in separate Facebook posts on Sunday night.

Pritom explained that after a ten-year journey together, they decided to separate due to significant differences in their mutual understanding. He noted that the decision was not sudden and was made after much thought and discussion.

Shahtaj shared a similar statement, confirming that the separation is amicable and based on mutual understanding. Both expressed gratitude for the memories and experiences they shared over the last decade.

The couple stated that the decision was reached with the support and consent of their families. They are currently going through the legal process of divorce.

Pritom and Shahtaj first met in 2017 while working on the music video for Pritom's song 'Jadukor', where Shahtaj appeared as a model. Their professional relationship later evolved into a romantic one.

They married on October 29, 2022, in Sreemangal, in the presence of family and close friends. They had been seen together as recently as January this year.

Both have requested respect for their privacy and personal space during this transition. They asked friends, colleagues, and the media to approach the matter with empathy.
